nom: Thayers pH Balancing Daily Cleanser with Aloe Vera

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one who specifically notes T-zone oiliness, mostly report the cleanser leaves skin feeling less oily with smaller-looking pores and no stripping, though one reviewer with normally oily skin found it left her skin a little too dry.
segments.dry: The few reviewers who describe their own skin as dry report the cleanser itself does not add dryness and even reduces it, though one notes she still layers her usual moisturizer on top right after since her skin is naturally dry.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin mostly report the cleanser cleans without adding oiliness or dryness and calms breakouts, though one reviewer with oily-combination skin says it simply isn't her personal preference and would suit drier skin better.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including several with eczema or rosacea, consistently report the cleanser causes no irritation, redness, or stinging and call it gentle enough for daily use.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers across skin types report the cleanser does not leave skin feeling dry, tight, or stripped, with several calling it unusually hydrating for a foaming cleanser; a minority disagree, including one reviewer who developed dry patches under her eyes after use and another whose normally oily skin felt slightly too dry afterward.
concerns.redness: A handful of reviewers, several with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin, report the cleanser reduces redness and calms irritation, with no reviewer in this set reporting new redness from using it.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers credit the aloe vera and hyaluronic acid with protecting or supporting the moisture barrier rather than stripping it, including one who specifically says it doesn't break down her skin barrier.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers mention lighter sun spots or brighter-looking skin after weeks of use, though this is a minor, secondary observation rather than the cleanser's main reported effect.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report fewer breakouts, calmer active pimples, or clearer pores including blackheads with regular use; a small number say they saw no real change in existing acne, though none report the cleanser triggering new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers, including ones who describe their own skin as oily or oily in the T-zone, report smaller-looking pores and less shine after washing, though one reviewer with normally oily skin found her skin left slightly too dry rather than balanced.

aspects.libelle: Doesn't fully remove makeup on its own
Marketed fragrance-free but scent still noticeable
Gentle jelly-to-foam texture that lathers easily
Large bottle offers strong value for money
Mild lather that doesn't foam up much

extraits.titre: This product did not work for me.
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Unfortunately, this product did not work for me. After using the Thayer Daily Cleanser, I noticed almost immediately that my face didn't "feel" clean. I prefer a cleanser that suds up. This felt like I was rubbing aloe vera gel all over my face. A few days into using this cleanser, I developed dry patches under my eyes that took a week to clear up. I hope someone out there was able to make this work for them. I cannot recommend this to anyone though.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] While this cleanser removed dirt and oil well, it just isn't a perfect match for my preferences and skin. It suds decent, but I prefer more of a soapy lather. It left my normally oily skin feeling a little dry after use , almost too dry. I did like the packaging and the easy dispensing pump.
I used this on some sun spots and my face for 30 days. This definitely helped lighten the sun spots on my cheek. It goes on clean and stays clean. Great product.

extraits.titre: Effective as the second step in double cleansing
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is my second time using a Thayers product and I really quite liked it! The cleanser smells nice but not overpowering, is a good consistency (not too watery, not too viscous), and most importantly cleansed my skin really nicely. I double cleanse, so I used it as my second cleansing step after using a cleansing balm, since I wear waterproof makeup. You can see in my before/after pics that I was left with my natural skin, completely bare and clean. A couple things to note: -I have very sensitive skin and often get eczema; I'm happy to report that I had zero irritation to this cleanser. I'm pleased to have it as part of my rotation! -it's supposed to leave your skin feeling balanced. My skin didn't feel super tight after, but my skin type is dry, so I definitely had to put my usual skincare on top right after.

extraits.titre: Works well with my combination type of skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My job can be really stressful and we are always tend to go out in the field! My skin is sensitive and I have a combination of dry to oily skin that can easily breakout. It's really hard for me to find the right one that balance my skin's barrier and takes care of my skin problem like acne. This PH Balancing daily cleanser works well with my skin. It doesn't have a scent and good for sensitive skin. It makes my pimple and acne calmed down and dries up quickly! It lathers good and my face feels so soft and smooth every wash!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cleanser is more on the oily side but doesn't feel heavy on the skin and it start foaming nicely once you add water. I have used it for a while now and I do feel the skin being striped from oily or large pores and I really like the fact that my face feels less textured. It does not make face irritated or red. The packaging is very simple with the pump but otherwise easy to use. Nice cleanser that minimizes pores and leaves skin fresh and clean.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is great as a cleanser on my sensitive skin. Really brings down the redness and irritation. Also tends not to dry out my skin like other clensers. It lathers well to form a nice layer on the skin that slowly washes off with water. The moisturizer in this cleanser quickly absorb into my skin for refreshing look. Lack of scent is a big plus as product is designed for sensitive skin. All in all very impressed with the thayer ph balance cleanser.
